introHeading: The Mirror X on the Jersey City waterfront
introParas: Exchange Place and Newport are lined with corporate towers that face the Hudson directly, and a lot of our Jersey City bookings in those buildings are company parties and product launches rather than weddings. The Mirror X fits that setting the way our gold-framed mirror does not — six feet of frameless glass with no wooden trim, set up near a window and the Manhattan skyline shows up behind every photo without any extra design work.

It runs the same interactive touchscreen, DSLR photography and studio lighting as the original mirror, and every corporate feature is available on it — a branded start screen, custom overlays, a logo lockup print template, and opt-in data capture if your team wants the leads. Because Jersey City sits one PATH stop from Manhattan, we see a lot of company events here that also invite a Manhattan-based team or client list, and the Mirror X's start screen is a clean first impression for guests walking in.

Space and power match our other mirror booth: 10ft x 10ft optimal, 8ft x 8ft minimum with 7.5ft of ceiling clearance, one standard 110V outlet within 15 feet. Setup takes about 20 minutes and we arrive a full hour before your start time; idle time before that is $150 per hour, worth knowing if your building's vendor access window opens early. There is no travel fee for most Jersey City venues — we quote it from your venue ZIP code before you book.

faqHeading: Mirror X Booth in Jersey City — FAQ

faqs.q: Is the Mirror X a good fit for a Jersey City waterfront corporate event?
faqs.a: Yes — set up near a window in an Exchange Place or Newport tower and the Manhattan skyline shows up behind every photo, and the frameless glass profile matches the glass-and-steel buildings along the water better than a gold wooden frame would.

faqs.q: Can we brand the Mirror X for our company's product launch?
faqs.a: Yes — a branded start screen, custom overlays, a print template with your logo lockup, and opt-in data capture if your marketing team wants the leads. Send your brand assets after booking and our design team builds the experience around them.

faqs.q: Do you charge a travel fee to bring the Mirror X to Jersey City?
faqs.a: No travel fee for most Jersey City venues — Jersey City is a short hop from our Brooklyn base. We quote it from your venue ZIP code before you book.

faqs.q: How much space does the Mirror X need in an Exchange Place or Newport tower?
faqs.a: 10ft x 10ft is optimal, and we compress to 8ft x 8ft with 7.5ft of ceiling clearance for a tighter conference room, with one standard 110V outlet within 15 feet.

faqs.q: Can you arrive early if our building's vendor access opens before our idle window?
faqs.a: Yes. We arrive a full hour before your scheduled start time as standard; if your building's access opens earlier than that, idle time runs $150 per hour.

faqs.q: Do you carry insurance and can you provide a COI for a Jersey City building?
faqs.a: Yes. Magic Mirror Brooklyn carries a $3 million liability insurance policy. If your building's management needs a certificate of insurance naming them as additionally insured, reply to your booking confirmation with their contact email and we will send it over.
Yes. A trained attendant runs the Mirror X for your full Jersey City booking — setup, guiding guests through the touchscreen, and coordinating with your event team as needed.

faqs.q: What is the difference between the Mirror X and the gold-framed magic mirror?
faqs.a: Feature for feature they are the same booth. The Mirror X is frameless glass built for a modern corporate floor along the waterfront; the original magic mirror has the classic gold frame most Jersey City weddings choose.
